notes: MG1655 electron-transport knockouts (ndh/cydB/appC, nuoB/cydB/appC, ndh/cyoB, nuoB/cyoB) and ALE endpoint clones of each, M9 + 4 g/l glucose, mid-log (A600 ~0.6; phase word stated in the design).
